book.name: Saame
book.title: KO E TOHI ʻOE NGAAHI SAAME

content.text: Mou fakamālō kia Sihova.
Mou fakamālō ki he huafa ʻo Sihova;
fakamālō kiate ia, ʻakimoutolu ko e kau tamaioʻeiki ʻa Sihova.
‌ʻAkimoutolu ʻoku tuʻu ʻi he fale ʻo Sihova, ʻi he ngaahi lotoʻā ʻoe fale ʻo hotau ʻOtua,
Fakamālō kia Sihova; he ʻoku angalelei ʻa Sihova:
hiva fakamālō ki hono huafa; he ʻoku mālie ia.
He kuo fili ʻe Sihova ʻa Sēkope maʻana,
mo ʻIsileli ko hono tofiʻa ʻoʻona.
He ʻoku ou ʻilo ʻoku lahi ʻa Sihova,
pea ʻoku māʻolunga hake hotau ʻEiki ʻi he ngaahi ʻotua kotoa pē.
Ko e meʻa kotoa pē naʻe finangalo ki ai ʻa Sihova, ko ia naʻa ne fai ʻi he langi,
mo māmani, ʻi he ngaahi tahi, mo e ngaahi potu loloto kotoa pē.
‌ʻOku pule ʻe ia ke ʻalu hake ʻae kakapu mei he ngaahi ngataʻanga ʻo māmani,
ʻoku ne ngaohi ʻae ngaahi ʻuhila mo e ʻuha ʻoku ʻomi,
ʻe ia ʻae matangi mei hono ngaahi feleoko.
Ko ia ia naʻe taaʻi ʻae ʻuluaki fānau ʻo ʻIsipite,
ʻae tangata mo e manu.
Mo ne fekau atu ʻae ngaahi fakaʻilonga,
mo e ngaahi meʻa fakaofo ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoʻou,
ʻE ʻIsipite, kia Felo, pea mo ʻene kau tamaioʻeiki kotoa pē.
Ko ia naʻe taaʻi ʻae ngaahi puleʻanga lahi,
mo tāmateʻi ʻae ngaahi tuʻi mālohi;
Ko Sihoni ko e tuʻi ʻoe kau ʻAmoli,
mo Oki ko e tuʻi ʻo Pesani,
mo e ngaahi puleʻanga kotoa pē ʻo Kēnani:
Pea naʻe foaki honau fonua ko e tofiʻa,
ko e tofiʻa ki ʻIsileli ko hono kakai.
‌ʻE Sihova, ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ho huafa;
mo ho fakamanatu,
ʻE Sihova, ki he ngaahi toʻutangata kotoa pē.
Koeʻuhi ʻe fakamaau ʻe Sihova hono kakai,
pea ʻe lolou ia koeʻuhi ko ʻene kau tamaioʻeiki.
Ko e ngaahi tamapua ʻoe hiteni ko e siliva mo e koula,
ko e ngāue ʻae nima ʻoe tangata.
‌ʻOku ai honau ngutu, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau lea;
ʻoku nau maʻu ʻae mata, ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau mamata;
‌ʻOku nau maʻu ʻae telinga,
ka ʻoku ʻikai tenau fanongo;
pea ʻoku ʻikai ha mānava ʻi honau ngutu.
Ko kinautolu ʻoku ngaohi ʻakinautolu ʻoku nau tatau mo kinautolu:
pea ʻoku pehē pe ʻakinautolu ʻoku falala ki ai.
‌ʻE fale ʻo ʻIsileli, ke ke fakafetaʻi kia Sihova:
ʻE fale ʻo ʻElone, ke ke fakafetaʻi kia Sihova:
‌ʻE fale ʻo Livai, ke ke fakafetaʻi kia Sihova:
ʻakimoutolu ʻoku manavahē kia Sihova, mou fakafetaʻi kia Sihova.
Mou fakafetaʻi kia Sihova mei Saione,
ʻaia ʻoku ʻafio ʻi Selūsalema.
Mou fakamālō kia Sihova.
